title: Install aws-cli from Alpine packages in release beta
message:
Install aws-cli from Alpine packages in release beta

The alpine/helm image is based on Alpine 3.24, where pip enforces
PEP 668 and a bare `pip install awscli` fails with
externally-managed-environment. Use the aws-cli package from the
Alpine community repository instead.

title: Update outdated tool versions in the CI pipeline
message:
Update outdated tool versions in the CI pipeline

Bump helm-unittest 0.3.4 -> 1.2.1, kind v0.20.0 -> v0.33.0,
kubectl v1.27.4 -> v1.37.1, docker 20.10.16 -> 29.9.2 and
alpine 3.18 -> 3.24.

Replace the gitlab-build-images Helm 3.7 base image with
alpine/helm, pin the Helm version used by the integration test to
the same HELM_VERSION, download kubectl from dl.k8s.io (the legacy
GCS bucket returns 404 for current versions) and use the docker
-cli image since -git variants are no longer published.

All versions are kept in CI variables so that they can be updated
in one place.

Closes #602
